title: Winning Souls and Wealth Through Seeking God's Kingdom
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges believers to take responsibility for winning souls and living a life of purpose, prosperity, and kingdom advancement. He shares a personal story of his own transformation from a rough-around-the-edges boxer to a servant of the Lord, and reminds us that God desires for every single believer to experience His blessing and become a blessing to others. Join Pastor Zehner as he unpacks the truth of seeking first the kingdom of God and living a life that reflects God's love and generosity.
